request.style: English, female solo voice, haunting and somber, acoustic guitar, cello, piano, 70 BPM, minor key
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Samuel is dead and buried in Ramah
All Israel mourned his passing away
Saul had driven mediums out of the land
But fear now gripped his trembling heart
Philistines camped at Shunem in sight
Israel waited at Gilboa that night
He inquired of the LORD for a sign
But no answer came through dream or line
Not by Urim nor by prophets' call
Silence held him in the empty hall

[Chorus]
Why have you disturbed me by bringing me up
The LORD has turned away and become your enemy
He has torn the kingdom out of your hand
And given it to David your neighbor today

[Verse]
Saul disguised himself in other clothes
Took two men to the woman at night
Asked her to consult a spirit for him
She asked who he would want to find
Bring up Samuel he whispered low
She cried out in a sudden flow
Why have you deceived me she exclaimed
I see you clearly you are Saul
An old man wrapped in a robe is coming
Rising up from the ground so lonely
Saul bowed his face to the dusty ground
Trembling before the prophet found

[Chorus]
Why have you disturbed me by bringing me up
The LORD has turned away and become your enemy
He has torn the kingdom out of your hand
And given it to David your neighbor today

[Bridge]
Because you did not obey the voice of the LORD
And failed his burning anger against Amalek
The LORD will hand both you and Israel over
To the Philistines in the dark
Tomorrow you and your sons will be with me
And the army will fall in defeat

[Outro]
Saul fell full length on the ground in fear
His strength was gone and his spirit broke
They ate and left in the dark of the night
With no hope left in the sight
